facts.value: The Study Service Point and the hotline are your central contact points for questions regarding studies, applications, and student administration.
The central study counseling supports you competently with all concerns related to studying.
The student secretariat is your reliable contact for all questions regarding the organization of your studies.
In the examination offices, you will find contacts for all formal matters regarding your academic performance, such as thesis submission, examination registration, or certificates.
Goethe University accompanies international students with comprehensive counseling and service offers throughout their academic journey from application to graduation.
The PBS offers support and a listening ear for personal concerns. Every semester, the PBS provides online lectures and workshops on topics such as self-reflection, resilience, and stress management.

The PSB supports students with personal and study-related challenges, such as anxiety, loneliness, relationship stress, or learning blocks. In addition to individual and couples counseling, there are also group offers.
In addition to a diverse sports program, university sports also offers courses and videos on stress management and self-assertion, as well as events to get active and make new contacts.

The Career Service supports students and alumni (up to 1 year after graduation) in starting their careers. Enhance your career skills through workshops, coaching, and networking. Free, practical, and individualized – your springboard into the job.
Goethe University promotes an equitable and critically discriminatory environment and stands for equality, diversity, and inclusion.
Counseling in cases of discrimination as well as measures for prevention and reduction of discrimination.
The ombudspersons are your contacts for problems, complaints, or suggestions for improvement regarding studies and doctoral programs.
The scholarship service supports students and employees across all disciplines. Find your scholarship and benefit from individualized counseling!
The student union offers affordable housing near the campus. Discover numerous dormitories, learn about rental prices, and apply online for your room.
BAföG, scholarships, part-time jobs, or loans – the student union in Frankfurt provides information on all options for study financing and offers individual counseling.
With our newsletter for students, parents, and teachers, we regularly inform you about the student offers at Goethe University.
